attributes.action: Lower University tuition fees; feed the youth, don’t hinder the future
attributes.background: To lower the costs education and university have as they restrict the youth into accessing high levels of education, further hindering the future of the UK. Perhaps, cap the tuition fees to a certain amount that is relatively affordable. Otherwise, the harm will cause an inevitable future of chaos.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government to do. You've asked for university tuition fees to be capped at a more affordable level, but you haven't said what you think the cap should be.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do, including the maximum tuition fee you would like to see introduced.

You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Cap tuition fees at £3000 retrospectively & write off the resulting student debt
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/766433

Fund free university and higher education
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772481
